summary.root_cause_text: The payment provider at internal://payments-v1 times out on every call. Orders are marked processed with no payment recorded. The cause of the provider failure is unknown and no available tool can fix it.
recommended: A human should investigate and restore the payment provider, or stop accepting orders until it is back.
Once payments succeed, run reprocess_orders all_unpaid. It never double-charges.
Do not restart the worker or reprocess while the provider is still timing out.
Add alerting on provider timeouts, which are currently logged only at DEBUG.
